remaining_gaps: Default product clone/fetch/push/pull and unconverted history/maintenance ref writers remain disabled.
Standalone donor conformance, including native local SHA-256 push, does not enable product transport or qualify checked SHA-256 receive-pack.
redb object storage is opt-in; refs, reflogs, indexes and existing packs remain filesystem formats. Complete pack ingestion, GC and coordinated backup are unfinished.
All Git flags/error modes, non-UTF-8 CLI paths, authenticated GitHub transport, complete bounded-memory reads, macOS and Windows remain unqualified.
Local redb multi-process serialization is not distributed HA.
The core Rust source import does not make transitive native TLS/OS dependencies pure Rust.

retained_evidence.raw_output_bytes: Not copied into this evidence directory; sizes and SHA-256 values for verified outputs are retained in artifact-manifest.json. The Rust fixture generator and original workflow artifact preserve their origin.
